title: Add tags to a file or folder
summary: Use the `tag` command to add one or more tags to a file or folder. Tags help you organize and find items in Finder and Spotlight.

steps.explain: Add one or more tags to a file. Separate multiple tags with commas.

placeholders.name: TAG_NAMES
placeholders.description: One or more tag names, separated by commas (no spaces after commas).

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file or folder to tag.

steps.expect: The command completes without output, indicating success.
